terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd backend && exec uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22 >/dev/null; cd frontend && exec npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
